messages:
deploy-bot: Deployment started: prod -> regional rollout (canary: us-east-1). Commit: 3b9f2d8 Tag: v3.7.0-rc2. Change window: 02:00-04:00 UTC.
maya: copying release notes to #release-notes, link: https://redwood/release/3.7.0-rc2 :party:
ajay: observed that canary weight is 5% for us-east. will watch latency and error-traces.
deploy-bot: us-east-1 finished canary OK (200/200 checks). promoting to eu-west-1 (25%).
jen: quick smoke in eu-west looks fine, no increased 5xx. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: eu-west-1 at 25% -> 100% complete. starting apac (ap-northeast-1) 10%.
sre-oncall: got alert from observability: apac sudden increase in tail latency ~1200ms. digging.
tomas: pulling logs, possible model shard contention. scaling policy has autoscale pending.
sre-oncall: adding node pool and forcing warm cache; holding apac rollout at 10%.
maya: decision? proceed with scaled capacity or rollback apac?
ajay: prefer pin-and-skip for apac until fix. canary for apac stays at 10% -> rollback to previous tag v3.6.4.
deploy-bot: executing regional pin: ap-northeast-1 pinned to v3.6.4. command:
```
redwood deploy --region ap-northeast-1 --pin-tag v3.6.4 --reason "latency spike apac"
```
jen: confirming pin applied. verified 0/200 errors after pin. :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall: monitoring continues. reopening capacity change ticket INF-442.
maya: documenting incident and rollback notes in release thread. we will re-schedule apac cutover next change window after fixes.
deploy-bot: Rollout summary: us-east-1 -> v3.7.0-rc2 (complete), eu-west-1 -> v3.7.0-rc2 (complete), ap-northeast-1 -> pinned back to v3.6.4 (rollback). Full finish timestamp: 1802456840.
ajay: thanks all. will open follow-up for hotfix and quantize kernel patch.
